events.summary: A GitHub security advisory and CVE-2026-53965 described an unbounded in-memory buffer in the HttpTransport component of the official Model Context Protocol PHP SDK (Composer package mcp/sdk). Versions 0.5.0 through 0.7.0 appended every incoming Server-Sent Events chunk to a buffer with no upper bound and only flushed it on the SSE event delimiter, so a malicious, compromised, or man-in-the-middle MCP server that withheld the delimiter could exhaust the client process's memory and deny service. Fixed in mcp/sdk 0.7.1.

supports: Default stateful Streamable HTTP sessions retained initialize payloads without bounded session counts or reclamation, including ended or refused sessions. Reachable clients could exhaust server memory.
sources.title: MCP Python stateful HTTP session memory exhaustion

supports: HTTP-reachable servers did not limit POST body size or JSON-RPC batch length, so large requests could exhaust memory and one long batch could block the server. stdio servers are excluded.

Affected: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >= 1.10.0, < 1.30.1; @modelcontextprotocol/server >= 2.0.0, < 2.1.0; @modelcontextprotocol/node >= 2.0.0, < 2.1.0; @modelcontextprotocol/hono >= 2.0.0, < 2.0.1. Patched: sdk 1.x: 1.30.1; server and node 2.x: 2.1.0; hono: 2.0.1.
sources.title: MCP TypeScript HTTP servers without body size or batch limits

supports: OAuth credentials were not bound to the authorization server that owned them. An untrusted MCP server could redirect saved refresh tokens, client secrets or signed assertions to another issuer.

sources.title: MCP TypeScript OAuth credential issuer confusion

supports: Messages were matched to connections by JSON-RPC id alone. When clients shared one stateless transport or one server instance, one client's responses and notifications could reach another client.

sources.title: MCP TypeScript shared server instances cross-deliver client messages

supports: Servers did not limit how many array elements and object keys they validated in one request, so one HTTP request inside the default 4 MiB limit could exhaust the heap.
Affected: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >= 1.3.0, < 1.32.0; @modelcontextprotocol/server >= 2.0.0, < 2.3.0. Patched: sdk 1.x: 1.32.0; server 2.x: 2.3.0.
sources.title: MCP TypeScript tool input validation memory exhaustion

supports: The official MCP PHP SDK (Composer package mcp/sdk) HttpTransport component appends every incoming Server-Sent Events chunk to an unbounded in-memory buffer, flushing only on the SSE event delimiter, so a malicious, compromised, or man-in-the-middle MCP server that withholds the delimiter can exhaust the client process's memory and deny service.
Fixed in mcp/sdk 0.7.1; affected versions 0.5.0 through 0.7.0.
sources.title: DoS: client HttpTransport SSE buffer (sseBuffer .= chunk) grows unbounded when server withholds the event delimiter
